Breakouts happen. But instead of punishing skin with complicated, drying routines, Posh Skin helps people hit refresh with the Posh Skin Acne Sheet Mask, a soothing, hydrating facial treatment designed to moisturize and calm stressed, blemish-prone skin

Instead of a complicated, drying routine, Posh Skin formulated this lightweight mask to help soothe, hydrate, and comfort blemish-prone skin in a simple step. Because sometimes, your skin just needs a reset.
Simply cleanse and dry your face, apply the sheet mask, and leave it on for 10 to 20 minutes. Remove the mask, rinse off if desired, or gently massage the remaining essence into your skin.
The Posh Skin Acne Sheet Mask brings together a combination of skin-loving ingredients to help soothe, hydrate, and refresh breakout-prone skin:
• Centella Asiatica – Helps soothe the appearance of redness and irritated skin
• Hyaluronic Acid – Replenishes moisture and prevents skin from feeling dry or tight
• Tea Tree – Purifies blemish-prone skin and keeps it feeling fresh
• Botanical Extracts – Calms and refreshes stressed skin
• Bonus: The formula is supercharged with Allantoin, Zinc PCA, Aloe, and multiple ceramides to give your skin barrier a healthy, comforting boost
♡ Made for breakout-prone skin – Designed to address blemish-prone and stressed-looking skin
♡ Soothe + hydrate – Centella Asiatica and Hyaluronic Acid help calm the skin and replenish its moisture
♡ Fresh, lightweight feel – The essence hydrates without feeling heavy or greasy
♡ No nasties – Made with vegan ingredients and free from SLES and parabens
♡ No animal testing – Skincare you can feel good about adding to your routine
